data.gender_notes: Ranjet is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ranjet is recorded with the meaning “Jewel of the mind”. Ranjet is a Hindu name meaning “Jewel of the mind”. in_marathi.name: Ranjet
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Jewel of the mind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ranjet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who possesses the most precious gem of intellect and wisdom
